name: Improved Rally
body:
Your ability to rally others makes you a natural leader of men.

Prerequisite(s): Human, Diplomacy 4 ranks or Intimidate 4 ranks

Benefit(s): When you use your rally racial ability, your skill check counts as a new Will saving throw for every ally—except yourself—within 30 ft. Allies must still be able to hear you, as normal. This effect functions only on allies who failed a Will save since your last turn.

Normal: Your rally racial ability affects one ally.
